parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group number. The number must be unique within the same enterprise, 2 to 20 characters in length, start with a letter, and contain only letters and digits. A maximum of 1,000 outbound call groups can be created per enterprise
parameters.help_zh: 说明：同一企业外呼组编号不能重复，外呼组编号长度为2-20，以字母开头，须同时且只能包含字母和数字，同一企业最多可创建1000个外呼组
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group name. The name cannot be empty, cannot exceed 50 characters in length, and must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format
parameters.help_zh: 说明：外呼组名称不能为空，长度不能大于50,需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The description. The description cannot exceed 100 characters in length and must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format
parameters.help_zh: 说明：描述长度不能大于100,需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
